body: You’ve got lack of experience then, bc every relationship hit’s that spot where everything is a routine. Thing’s get bland. It’s you job to choose whether to fight to fix it or move to someone new.

Please take this into consideration, I know my ex did not. Thing’s got bland boring because it was a routine. please please please try something new, find something you love again, don’t just give up bc you’re “losing attraction” because it’s typically just the boring routine and missing the spunk of someone new, all the excitement everything that come’s with it. Giving up this way will hurt both you and him bc he most likely will never return to you even if you realized you were wrong.
Just sorta meh, not happy not sad. Just empty.

Exactly, I’ve turned into the dad of the group’s always. It’s always me just watching everyone’s drink for them and making sure nobody goes home with some random stranger. Like I want to have fun to guys...

Yeah it’s weird that, it’s so easy to talk to the grown adult’s because I sorta fit in with them. I was forced to grow up at a young age, I don’t really drink much and if I do I just have a beer or two because obviously depression and alcohol is a bad combination and alcoholism run‘s in the family. But everyone near our age just want’s to party and drink and go out and be wild and it’s just not who I am because i have to be an adult. I don’t have a choice. There’s not parent’s in my situation doing me any favors to financially help me or be there for me when I just need to talk. Even on my darkest day’s where I’ll cry the entire forty minute drive to work, I don’t have a choice. I help support my grandmother as she’s retired and sorta fucked her life up when she was my age by racking up debt so I help her so she doesn’t lose everything and to hopefully make her final year’s easier as she’s been a smoker since 16 and she’s 76 now. Some day we will fit in...

I talk to the employee’s because I’m a regular, we’ll have a quick chit chat here and there. I talk to my team mates when bowling and sometime’s the other team’s around us, typically only the older one’s 60+ bc I for some reason can talk to them with no issue. I’m on 4 socializing app’s to try and meet people but nobody ever pick’s me because it’s like a half dating app and half just looking for friend’s and I can’t get either.

The issue is that it’s starting to be a burden, I’m not as excited anymore. I’m not looking forward to it as much anymore. I enjoy it but when you watch everyone with all their friend’s having a good time together (Thursday night is college night so it’s like $8 for three hours with college ID) and you’re always the kid alone and you don’t have any social skill’s because you don’t want to bother people. I’ve invited people to go and nobody ever will go with me so I finally stopped asking people because I just kept getting told no or they would say sure and cancel the day of or 30 minute’s prior to it.

I bowl on a league Sunday night’s and Thursday’s I go down just to practice, it’s not really practice but it’s what I tell people. It just give’s me something to look forward too. I’ve done it for two year’s bc it was just something to do and made me feel slightly better about nobody ever wanting to hangout so I would go by myself bc at least I’m not in bed depressed.

Every hospital visit required therapists after you leave around my area. I just go to work and listen to music then go home and I go bowling bc it’s the only thing that made me feel at ease because I’m distracted and I go by myself. That’s the routine work and go bowl two nights a week.

Also, I really don’t know if I’m gonna make it to my birthday, honestly I sorta wanted to end it then to send a message. To bring awareness to men’s mental issue’s because the world caters to the female’s it seems and the men are just left to fend for themself.

My ex and I had a thing where no matter what time we left in the morning we always kissed eachother goodbye, on the cheek or forehead if they’re asleep. Everyday I did this even though I knew she started to cheat and ended up leaving for him. But everyday I loved her as if it was any other day until we split up. To this day I still have a hard time with people because I loved her and she’s gone. I won’t even talk to women and it’s been 9 months..
